body:
If you had paid attention to what I had said, take a look.
http://avicus.net/forums/a4432f14e

Pete is clearly seen saying
"Congratulations to the newly promoted Sr Moderators! However, there is already a thread on the promotions, and one thread is all we need. :)
http://avicus.net/forums/a4432f14e 

Locking..."

As you can see, he is linking the same thread that already supposedly exists to the same exact thread, meaning that thread was wrongly locked..
